rationale: Builds on the current late-aligned recurrent-tail best while avoiding another byte-costly float rescue. The only recurrent-tail attention matrix still quantized at export is the first recurrent block's V projection, so this change tracks a post-roundtrip EMA target for that tensor during the quant-aware endgame. The hypothesis is that smoothing exactly the dequantized tensor used by final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact will recover some of the benefit of V rescue without spending artifact bytes or changing the hot forward path.
title: Roundtrip EMA On Quantized First Recurrent V
